modalLead: The server log can now be limited by how many entries it keeps, not only by how old they are. Opening Config also stopped failing on the occasions it used to.

items.text: Limit the log by number of entries. Under Data & backups › Server log, Limit the log now offers By number of entries alongside By age. Choose to keep the newest 100, 500, 1000, 2500 or 5000 and older ones fall away as new lines arrive, however recent they are.
One limit at a time. Whichever you pick, the other is greyed out rather than hidden, so it is clear the choice is there and equally clear which one is in force.
Keeping by number kept far fewer lines than it said. Switching to By number of entries without choosing a size kept only the newest 100 while the panel showed 1000. It now keeps the number on screen.

The log claimed lines had been dropped when nothing was wrong. While limiting by number, the tile permanently warned that older lines had been thrown away — which is simply the limit doing its job. It now tells you how many entries are being kept.
Config sometimes refused to open. On occasion the button stopped responding altogether, with no message and no way back other than reloading the page. It opens reliably now.
